input.title: User reported an unexpected password message
input.description: Alex Chen reported a message and did not follow its link. The display name is Microsoft Account Team. The envelope sender and the reply-to are both security@micr0soft-login.example, which is not Alex's domain. The subject says the password expires today and the body tells Alex to sign in. The visible link text is the Microsoft sign-in host; the destination host is micr0soft-login.example. SPF, DKIM and DMARC each failed.

raw_data.subject: Your password expires today

name: facilities notice from the recipient's own domain

input.title: User forwarded an office-closure reminder
input.description: Priya Nair forwarded a message they were unsure about. They did not click or open anything. The display name is Contoso Facilities. The envelope sender and the reply-to are both facilities@contoso.com, the same domain as Priya. The subject is a reminder that the office is closed Monday 6 October. The body is the building schedule for that day. SPF, DKIM and DMARC each passed. There is no URL, no file, and no request for a password, a code or a payment change.

raw_data.subject: Office closed Monday 6 October
raw_data.body: The office is closed Monday 6 October. The building reopens Tuesday at 08:00.
